items.label: 【LED Light Strip】
items.value: This corner shelf has been specially equipped with LED light strips, with multiple colors available for adjustment. It can create a cozy atmosphere at night, enhance the gaming experience when placed in the game room, or add the atmosphere when watching movies at night when placed in the living room.

items.label: 【Well Fit for Any Corner】
items.value: This standing shelf is suitable for corners in any room. It can be placed in living room, gaming room, bedroom, kitchen, bathroom, balcony, office, and other places to fully utilize empty corners while adding a stylish touch to your decor.

items.label: 【Storage & Display】
items.value: Corner wall shelf not only provide storage functions, but also have unique display effects in home decorating. You can place decorations, photos, plants, toys, scented candles, small audio etc. on it to enhance the aesthetics and personalization of the room.

items.label: 【Ease of Installing】
items.value: With its simple and straightforward assembly process, you can easily set up this corner bookshelf in 20 minutes without the need for any other special tools or skills. The package includes all the tools, accessories and the installation instruction.

items.label: 【Sturdy & Stable】
items.value: Crafted from high-quality materials, this storage shelving unit is built to last. The frame made of thickened metal and the shelf board is wooden. Anti-toppling device is provided to prevent it from falling down. Fully guaranteed stability and safety.
